contribution.position: Restating my position on the reliability axis: the change is not ready. artifact:perf-report shows a 3.4% peak-load error rate against a 1% budget — a 3.4x overshoot that QA's framing of '0.4% within budget' does not capture, since the budget breach appears precisely under peak load. The clean artifact:test-report (412 passed, 87% coverage) confirms functional correctness but evidently misses peak-load behavior, and artifact:incident-log's two prior sev2 retry-storm incidents suggest this failure mode is exactly how auth changes hurt us in production. The reliability evidence points the wrong way.
